caseContext.description: Sanitized ACME Health provider onboarding case details.

intakePacketText.description: Optional text from the intake packet, email, or uploaded forms.

sourceChannel.description: Optional source channel for the intake packet, such as manual intake, upload, email, or transfer.

hireCategory.description: Classified hire category, such as new hire, transfer, reactivation, locum, or unknown.

providerSpecialty.description: Provider specialty or unknown when not grounded in the input.

sourcePacketType.description: Classified packet type or unknown when not grounded in the input.

requiredForms.description: Forms or evidence required for this case.

missingItems.description: Required intake items that appear missing or incomplete.

reviewNeeded.description: True when a human reviewer should resolve ambiguity or missing data.

reviewReason.description: Short reason for human review, or an empty string when review is not needed.
